findings.finding: Manifest parsed before replay is not the byte object hashed into the final receipt. A concurrent proposal manifest edit during replay can bind old rows to a new hash.
findings.remediation: Read manifest bytes once, parse and hash those bytes, and assert current bytes are unchanged before receipt write.

verified: Native writer validates schema before writing.
Destinations derive only from UUID run directory and hashed proposal ID under repository-private .temp.
Parsed YAML roundtrip equality and original capture unchanged are checked.
Native prepare now explicitly hashes the replay helper and its receipt.
limitations: Static read-only review; actual complete replay remains coordinator-owned.
